author: TheDanMarsh
body:
I don't know if there is a limit on shops.
However, I have over 125 of them if that helps you assess how far you can potentially go.
I can confirm that they do not increase in price the more you build. (Only upgrading them to level 10 will cost further funds).

I mainly use them to collect monster remains.

author: Muted-Effective-1713
body:
Level 210 here. I have a few zones with 50 plus shops and a refinery in each one. I don't use the shops so much anymore because the dismantling gives mats that are useless to me. It's not a waste because honestly they are cheap to build and max level them.  Gold stops being a thing, I have billions upon billions. The potions they sell stop helping. I almost strictly use them to aqlcquire massive amounts of monster remains.  I'll pay to reset 50 to a hundred buildings for millions of dollars regularly because its easier than walking down the street to save on a currency I will never use. Boss fights all day. Honestly the refinery is not very helpful for t9 and 10 mats especially.  Tip on refining mats is the background color is rarity essentially. Mats with blue or purple will get far superior results than one of a higher tier but average rarity.

But yeah orns become a slight pain coming up with 10 million at once but I get 10 thousand for logging in,  and 50k for a boss mode dungeon on hard. Gauntlet keys are more of an issue but that's why I buy so many monster remains. Raid bosses are where your mats wj come from via dismember.

Can usually generate a million orns a week if needed. Eventually panacea becomes no longer a consideration in early t9 or late to. Everything but world bosses and raids become so sadly easy you may lose motivation to play. They're only hard because of the one shot moves. I'm immune to debuffs, most status effects, and most damage types to where I can watch TV and just hit attack without looking. I'm not specd for magic or pets but he one shots  a lot of normal bosses and enemies very commonly. I have a few demonforged and masterforged perfect or near perfect ornates from t8. That took some serious grinding but my guild has no limit on how many times you can fight raid bosses, just a damage per fight setting.  Haven't lost a guild war on my part in months..
